node.statement: Coarse amplified column-norm comparison follows directly from the registered ground-truth definitions. By def-hcb-datum, Q is one-dimensional; one-dimensional-projection-nonvanishing makes Q nonvanishing. The registered nonvanishing, theta/compression, and epsilon-Cstar axioms therefore give universal c_u,C_u>0 and e_u>0 with c_u<=||u_Q||<=C_u for e<=e_u. For an amplified column U, column-hilbert-inner-product-displays gives the exact Gram identity U^dagger dot U=q_T(U)^2 u_Q. Comparing the compressed product with U^dagger U by compressed-product-display and comparing ||U^dagger U|| with ||U||^2 by epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms gives two inequalities q_T(U)^2 c_u<=C||U||^2 and ||U||^2<=C q_T(U)^2 C_u+C e||U||^2. Shrinking the universal threshold so that the last term is absorbed yields K_q^{-1}||U||<=q_T(U)<=K_q||U||, uniformly in the amplification. This is a coarse consequence and does not invoke the excluded false 1+O(e) amplified formula.
